salesforceExclusionReason: The fixture relies on the deterministic local Qualified lead-conversion status, which is not portable to the clean target org's LeadStatus set; it grants zero Salesforce parity credit.
name: data-database-convert-lead-runtime

evidence.notes: Direct org-state execution converts a LeadConvert and returns a successful LeadConvertResult.
A single explicit LeadConvert converts a Lead and creates Account and Contact records.
A single explicit LeadConvert with AccessLevel converts a Lead and returns populated result IDs.
A single explicit LeadConvert with allOrNone converts a Lead and returns populated result IDs.
A single explicit LeadConvert with allOrNone and AccessLevel converts a Lead.
A single explicit LeadConvert with DMLOptions converts a Lead.
A statically typed LeadConvert list converts in order and returns populated result rows.
A statically typed LeadConvert list with AccessLevel converts in order.
A statically typed LeadConvert list with allOrNone converts in order.
A statically typed LeadConvert list with allOrNone and AccessLevel converts in order.
A statically typed LeadConvert list with DMLOptions converts in order.

source.content: Lead l0 = new Lead(FirstName = 'Ada', LastName = 'Convert Zero', Company = 'Company Zero', Status = 'Open'); insert l0; Database.LeadConvert c0 = new Database.LeadConvert(); c0.setLeadId(l0.Id); c0.setConvertedStatus('Qualified'); c0.setDoNotCreateOpportunity(true); Database.LeadConvertResult r0 = Database.convertLead(c0); System.assert(r0.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(l0.Id, r0.getLeadId()); System.assertNotEquals(null, r0.getAccountId()); System.assertNotEquals(null, r0.getContactId()); Id accountId0 = r0.getAccountId(); Id contactId0 = r0.getContactId(); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id = :accountId0].size());
